sentences.text: The provided policy materials do not state a specific late payment fee for credit card dues.
The UCB directions say the policy shall clearly lay down the liability by way of interest payments due to delays for non-compliance with the standards set by the bank itself.

The cited penal-charges provisions require a Board-approved policy and say penal charges must be reasonable, disclosed, and not levied as penal interest, but they do not give a credit-card late fee amount.

missing.slot: specific late payment fee amount or formula for credit card dues
missing.searched: searched the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 and the superseded Fair Lending Practice - Penal Charges in Loan Accounts, plus the pre-payment directions; none of the cited provisions state a credit-card late payment fee amount
